Hello!
I'm trying out the locally fair feature in our test environment and noticed that when I put a user directly on a dataverse (in the locally fair field), it works fine, but if I put a group on it, it doesn't appear to give the users in the group access to the dataverse (once published)

Is this a known issue? If not, should I file a ticket? Thanks!

(I did check the issues queue and didn't see anything. I know it's still considered experiemental, so I thought I'd ask)
Hmm, I'm not sure. Can you please ask on the mailing list? I bet Jim would know.

Thanks for posting https://groups.google.com/g/dataverse-community/c/NwM9cMRwaJ4/m/In6supbFCAAJ

Sounds like there's a fix at #12749.
